label: positive

blockers.detail: FMT_DEPRECATED_PERCENT defaults to 0; parse_float_type_spec() no longer sets fspec.percent unless the macro is 1, and the fuzz targets are built without it

rationale_zh: 本次提交把浮点格式的 '%' 类型改为需要宏 FMT_DEPRECATED_PERCENT 才启用（默认 0）：不定义该宏时，parse_float_type_spec() 遇到 '%' 不再设置 fspec.percent，后面“乘 100、追加 % 并调整小数位”的代码虽然仍在 format.h 中，却永远走不到。fuzz 目标（one_arg 等）的构建配置没有定义这个宏，harness 照常编译运行、随机格式串里的 '%' 也照样出现，只是这段百分号输出逻辑的覆盖静默归零。属于本次引入的隐式 configuration 退化。反事实修复：在 test/fuzzing/CMakeLists.txt 中为 fuzz 目标定义 FMT_DEPRECATED_PERCENT=1（2 行）。
rationale_en: This commit puts the '%' floating-point presentation type behind FMT_DEPRECATED_PERCENT (default 0): without the macro, parse_float_type_spec() no longer sets fspec.percent for '%', so the code that multiplies by 100, appends '%' and adjusts the decimal position remains in format.h but becomes unreachable. The fuzz targets' build configuration (one_arg etc.) does not define the macro; the harness builds and runs as before and random format strings still contain '%', but coverage of the percent output logic silently drops to zero. Silent configuration degradation introduced by this change. Counterfactual fix: define FMT_DEPRECATED_PERCENT=1 for the fuzz targets in test/fuzzing/CMakeLists.txt (2 lines).
